gen-gf-unkempt-gf-imprima: Unkempt shouts with a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and gaps that keep its c from collapsing into an o. Imprima follows with smooth, tube-like lines and terminals that flare outward.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-inclusive-sans: Unkempt leads with a hand-made swagger, its t built from a crossbar and stem of matching weight. Inclusive Sans handles the rest, with round letters whose rims match the stems and curves left open at the ends.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-istok-web: Diagonals as heavy as the verticals give Unkempt its blunt, commanding punch, while Istok Web counters with rounded letters and a clearly open side. One shouts, one talks.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-jost: Jost draws every letter with a unit-width stroke and broad gaps at the terminals, which keeps the text clean and professional. Give Unkempt the bigger size, since it is the one that wants attention.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-jura: Loud meets wiry. Unkempt hammers out its commanding display letters, while Jura bends constant strokes into s curves that open wide at both ends, giving the eye somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-k2d: Rough and loud up top, with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight and a c that stays distinct from o. K2D keeps its tube-like thickness through every bend.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kantumruy-pro: Approachable is how Kantumruy Pro feels, its e opening clearly to the right with no hairlines or swells. Shrink Unkempt down and its commanding, expressive energy gets lost, so give it room to speak.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kodchasan: A t with crossbar and stem of matching weight gives Unkempt its expressive, commanding bluntness. Kodchasan then takes over with open-hanging terminals and no calligraphic thinning, keeping the text clean.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-koho: Round bowls with walls that never swell or taper give Unkempt its stubborn presence. KoHo, a plain sans, answers with wide c apertures and a quiet, clean manner.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kosugi: Kosugi has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers and a wire-bent look across each word. And Unkempt brings the commanding, expressive voice that those wiry text letters leave to someone else.
